test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Identify the correctly spelt sentence.

options.text: The events arranged or organised in order of time are known as chronoligal order.
The events arranged or organised in order of time are known as chronological order.
The events arranged or organised in order of time are known as chronologikal order.
The events arranged or organised in order of time are known as chronoloigal order.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 The correct spelling is **"chronological order."**
 
• The word **"chronological"** relates to arranging events, items, or actions in the order they occurred in time.
 
• The** sentence describes **the concept of organizing events based on their chronological sequence.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'The events arranged or organised in order of time are known as chronological order.*
